title: How to Prepare a Brand Strategy Project Before Hiring
h1: How to prepare a brand strategy project before hiring
description: Prepare a brand strategy project: purpose, audience, positioning, competitors, voice, deliverables and how strategy connects to logo and design work.
intro: Brand strategy is the thinking behind how a business presents itself: who it serves, what it stands for and why customers should choose it. A logo and colors express that thinking, but they cannot replace it. Hiring a strategist works best when you arrive prepared. This article explains what to think about, what to share and what a useful strategy project should deliver.

faq.q: What is the difference between brand strategy and a logo?
faq.a: Strategy defines who you are for and how you are different. A logo is one visual expression of that.
Ideally before design, so the visual identity and messages follow a clear direction.
Often a document covering audience, positioning, voice and key messages, sometimes with a short presentation or workshop.
Yes. Even a short strategy helps you decide what to say and what to ignore.
Small projects can take a couple of weeks, depending on research and revisions.
